submissionNotes.jupiter: VRFD requires wallet-connected submission or metadata contribution and human/community review.
submissionNotes.dexScreener: Token listing is automatic when a supported pool is indexed and has transactions; token metadata can later inherit from external token lists such as CoinGecko.
submissionNotes.phantom: Phantom has no direct token-verification form; recognition by trusted data providers such as Jupiter or CoinGecko is a useful upstream signal.
submissionNotes.solscan: Use the official Token Update form. A project-domain email is preferred; otherwise the requester email should be visibly listed on the official website.
submissionNotes.coinGecko: New listing requires a CoinGecko account and a public verification post from an official project social account linked from the project website.
